# Vita Eterna Aesthetics

> Doctor led medical aesthetics clinic run by Dr Rishi Mangat inside Healthmaxx Hospital, Kharar, Punjab, India.

Vita Eterna offers facial balancing (Botox, dermal fillers, threads, biostimulators), skin rejuvenation (microneedling, mesotherapy, PRP/GFC, skin boosters, chemical peels), IV wellness therapy, and hair management (laser hair removal, hair loss treatment).

## Pages

- [Home](https://vitaeterna.com/): Clinic overview, treatments, credentials, FAQ and consultation booking
- [About](https://vitaeterna.com/about): Dr Rishi's background and the clinic's approach
- [Contact](https://vitaeterna.com/contact): Address, phone, email and opening hours
- [Privacy Policy](https://vitaeterna.com/privacy): How booking enquiry data is used
- [Terms of Service](https://vitaeterna.com/terms): Terms for using the website and booking consultations
- [Editorial Policy](https://vitaeterna.com/editorial-policy): How website content is written and reviewed
